pages.text: Small creatures offer their own transport and exchange interactions.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Forest/plains mice like Pumpkin Seeds; a pot preserves the passenger. Wet-biome Squonks can return a gift for a cookie, without becoming tamed.
